title: "snRNA-seq PBS vs AEC: oligodendrocyte lineage cells"
author: "Yuxi"
date: "2022-11-24"
output: html_document
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Single nuclei RNA-seq of one PBS-treated and one AEC-treated mouse. Ambient RNA was removed with CellBender.
This script was written for Seurat v4. To run it with Seurat v5, keep `options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")` in the setup chunk.

Oligodendrocytes and OPCs: subclustering, DEGs between conditions, gene panels and lineage inference.
Starts from `data/nuclei/Nuclei_DATA.rds`, saved by `01_QC_integration_annotation.Rmd`. Gene panels: `data/gene_panels/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r load all the packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")
library(DoubletFinder)
library(cowplot)
library(clustree)
library(niceRplots)
library(scCustomize)
library(harmony)
library(gprofiler2)
library(geomtextpath)
library(webr)
library(plotly)
library(sparseMatrixStats)
library(rafalib)
library(slingshot)

dir.create("results/nuclei/Ols", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("results/nuclei/Neuron", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("results/nuclei/ASCs", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("results/nuclei/FBs", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r Oligodendrocytes lineage Cells}
DATA <- readRDS("data/nuclei/Nuclei_DATA.rds")
DATA_OLs <- DATA %>% SetIdent(value = "Celltypes") %>% subset(idents = c("OPCs", "Oligodendrocyte"))

#Get rid of mitochondrial Genes
DATA_OLs <- DATA_OLs[!grepl("^mt", rownames(DATA_OLs)), ]
DefaultAssay(DATA_OLs) <- "CCA"
DATA_OLs <- ScaleData(DATA_OLs, features = rownames(DATA_OLs))
DATA_OLs <- RunPCA(DATA_OLs, npcs = 30)
DATA_OLs <- RunUMAP(DATA_OLs, dims = 1:30, n.components = 3)
DATA_OLs@reductions$umap3d <- DATA_OLs@reductions$umap
DATA_OLs <- RunUMAP(DATA_OLs, dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(DATA_OLs ,group.by = "Celltypes", split.by = "Condition")
# Redo the clustering ----
DATA_OLs <- FindNeighbors(DATA_OLs, dims = 1:30, k.param =10)

for (res in c(0.1, 0.15,0.16,0.17,0.18,0.2,0.25,0.3,0.35,0.4,0.45, 0.5,0.55,0.6,0.65,0.75, 1,1.25, 1.5,1.75, 2,2.25, 2.5,3)) {
  print(paste0("current res", res))
    DATA_OLs <- FindClusters(DATA_OLs, graph.name = "CCA_snn", resolution = res, algorithm = 1)
}

clustree(DATA_OLs@meta.data, prefix = "CCA_snn_res.")


# Lets go for resolution 0.17
DATA_OLs <- SetIdent(DATA_OLs, value = "CCA_snn_res.0.17")
DATA_OLs$seurat_clusters <- DATA_OLs$CCA_snn_res.0.17
DimPlot(DATA_OLs, group.by = "CCA_snn_res.0.17", label = T)

#Generate DEGs----
DefaultAssay(DATA_OLs) <-  "RNA"
detable_all <- FindAllMarkers(DATA_OLs, log2FC.threshold = 0.2,
    min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.2, only.pos = TRUE, max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
    assay = "RNA")

detable_all <- detable_all[ detable_all$p_val < 0.05,  ]
detable_all$pct.diff <- detable_all$pct.1 - detable_all$pct.2
detable_all$log.pct.diff <- log2(detable_all$pct.1 / (detable_all$pct.2+0.01) )

detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-10, p_val) %>% top_n(5, log.pct.diff) -> top5_all
detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-50, p_val) %>% top_n(20, log.pct.diff) -> top20_all
write.csv(top20_all, file = "results/nuclei/Ols/Major_Markers_All_top20.csv")
write.csv(detable_all, file = "results/nuclei/Ols/Major_Markers_All.csv")
write.csv(top5_all, file = "results/nuclei/Ols/Major_Markers_Top5.csv")

plot_dots(DATA_OLs, genes = top5_all$gene, clustering = "seurat_clusters")
plot_dots(DATA_OLs, genes = c("Bcan","Pcdh15", "Pdgfra", "Sox6","Tnr","Cspg4",#OL progenitor
                              "Bcas1", "Enpp6","Gpr17","Bmp4","Neu4", #transitional
                              "Cldn11", "Opalin", "Plp1","St18",#OL
                              "B2m", "Cd74", "Clu", "Hif3a","Hspb1", "Ptma", "Cryab", "Fth1", "Hsp90aa1","Mapk8ip1","Faim2","Atf4", "Ubb", "Ifngr1", "Ifngr2", "Il33","Tns3","Fyn","Tcf7l2","Casr","H2-D1",
                              "Mbp","Sox10", "Atg4a", "Mag", "Mog","Mobp", "Olig2", "Olig1", "Olig3"),assay = "RNA",clustering = "seurat_clusters", pal = c("#cfc8d7","#a577f2", "#0434ff"))

#Annotate the Dataset----
DATA_OLs <- SetIdent(DATA_OLs, value = "CCA_snn_res.0.17")
new.ids <- c("Oligo 3",
             "Oligo 2",
             "OPC 2",
             "COP",
             "OPC 1",
             "Oligo 5",
             "Oligo 1",
             "Oligo 4")

new.ids <- setNames(new.ids,as.character(0:(length(new.ids)-1) ))
DATA_OLs$Subtypes <- new.ids [ match( as.character(DATA_OLs$CCA_snn_res.0.17) , names(new.ids))  ]

DimPlot(DATA_OLs,group.by = "Subtypes" )+ ggtitle('Oligodendrocyte Lineage Cells')
VlnPlot(DATA_OLs, features = c("Ptprc","Cd274","H2-D1","H2-K1","Cd80","Cd74"), group.by = "Subtypes")
VlnPlot(DATA_OLs, features = c("Taco1","H2-K1","H2-D1", "Atg4a","Spock3", "Cadm2", "Grid2", "Mog", "Mag","Mobp","Mbp", "Ptprc", "Grm3", "Pdgfa", "Cd63","Cd81"), group.by = "Subtypes")

saveRDS(DATA_OLs, "data/nuclei/Nuclei_DATA_OL.rds")

#Proportion of each Condition under OL subtypes ----
summarized.df <- DATA_OLs@meta.data %>%
  group_by(Condition, Subtypes) %>%
  summarize(nCells = n()) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  mutate(prop = nCells/sum(nCells))

ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = summarized.df, aes(Condition, prop, fill = Subtypes), stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  coord_flip()

PieDonut(summarized.df, aes(Condition,Subtypes, count = nCells),r0 = 0.3, ratioByGroup = T,showRatioThreshold = 0, labelpositionThreshold = 0.1)
```

```{r Oligodendrocytes}
# Re-do the Calculation for Oligodendrocytes----
DATA_OLs <- readRDS("data/nuclei/Nuclei_DATA_OL.rds")
DATA_Oligo <- DATA_OLs %>% SetIdent(value = "Subtypes") %>% subset(idents = c("Oligo 1","Oligo 2","Oligo 3","Oligo 4", "Oligo 5"))

DefaultAssay(DATA_Oligo) <- "CCA"
DATA_Oligo <- ScaleData(DATA_Oligo, features = rownames(DATA_Oligo))
DATA_Oligo <- RunPCA(DATA_Oligo, npcs = 30)
DATA_Oligo <- RunUMAP(DATA_Oligo, dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(DATA_Oligo, split.by = "Condition")
# Redo the clustering ----
DATA_Oligo <- FindNeighbors(DATA_Oligo, dims = 1:30, k.param =7)

for (res in c(0.1, 0.15,0.16,0.17,0.18,0.2,0.25,0.3,0.35,0.4,0.45, 0.5,0.55,0.6,0.65,0.75, 1,1.25, 1.5,1.75, 2,2.25, 2.5,3)) {
  print(paste0("current res", res))
    DATA_Oligo <- FindClusters(DATA_Oligo, graph.name = "CCA_snn", resolution = res, algorithm = 1)
}

clustree(DATA_Oligo@meta.data, prefix = "CCA_snn_res.") #resolution set to 0.2

#Annotation
DATA_Oligo <- SetIdent(DATA_Oligo, value = "CCA_snn_res.0.2")
new.ids <- c("Oligo 2",
             "Oligo 1",
             "Oligo 5",
             "Oligo 4",
             "Oligo 3")

new.ids <- setNames(new.ids,as.character(0:(length(new.ids)-1) ))
DATA_Oligo$Subtypes <- new.ids [ match( as.character(DATA_Oligo$CCA_snn_res.0.2) , names(new.ids))  ]
DimPlot(DATA_Oligo, group.by = "Subtypes", pt.size =2) + ggtitle("Oligodendrocyte Subclusters")

saveRDS(DATA_Oligo,"data/nuclei/Nuclei_DATA_Oligo.rds")


#DEGs between conditions in Oligos----
DefaultAssay(DATA_Oligo) <- "RNA"
DATA_Oligo <- DATA_Oligo %>% SetIdent(value= "Condition")
detable_all <- FindAllMarkers(DATA_Oligo, log2FC.threshold = 0.25,
    min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.2, only.pos = TRUE, max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
    assay = "RNA")

detable_all <- detable_all[ detable_all$p_val < 0.05,  ]
detable_all$pct.diff <- detable_all$pct.1 - detable_all$pct.2
detable_all$log.pct.diff <- log2(detable_all$pct.1 / (detable_all$pct.2+0.01) )
detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-50, p_val) %>% top_n(10, log.pct.diff) -> top10_all

plot_dots(DATA_Oligo, genes = c(as.character(unique(top10_all$gene))),assay = "RNA",clustering = "Subtypes", pal = c("#cfc8d7","#a577f2", "#0434ff"),show_grid = F,main = "DEG in Oligo",cex.row = 0.8,cex.col = 0.7)
plot_dots(DATA_Oligo, genes = c("C1qb","C4b","Csf1","Cd81","Cd63"),assay = "RNA",clustering = "Subtypes", pal = c("#cfc8d7","#a577f2", "#0434ff"),show_grid = F,main = "DEG in Oligo",cex.row = 0.8,cex.col = 0.7)

write.csv(top10_all, file = "results/nuclei/Ols/Oligo_top10.csv")
write.csv(detable_all, file = "results/nuclei/Ols/Oligo_DEG_Condition.csv")


#Gene panels on Oligos----
for (panel in c("metabolic pannel", "Neuroinflammation", "Innate Immunity")) {
a <- read.delim(paste0("data/gene_panels/", panel, ".txt"), header = F)
b <- as.vector(a$V1)%>% unique()
c <- intersect(rownames(DATA_Oligo[["RNA"]]@data),b)
DATA_Oligo2<- ScaleData(DATA_Oligo,features = c)
ord_all <- factor(sapply(c,function(x){getcluster(DATA_Oligo2, x, "Condition")}))
d<-c[order(as.character(ord_all) )]
print(DoHeatmap(DATA_Oligo2, group.by = "Condition", features = d)+
 theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 2)) + ggtitle(panel))
}
```

```{r OPCs}
# Re-do the Calculation for OPCs----
DATA_OLs <- readRDS("data/nuclei/Nuclei_DATA_OL.rds")
DATA_OPCs <- DATA_OLs %>% SetIdent(value = "Subtypes") %>% subset(idents = c("OPC 1","OPC 2","COP"))

DefaultAssay(DATA_OPCs) <- "CCA"
DATA_OPCs <- ScaleData(DATA_OPCs, features = rownames(DATA_OPCs))
DATA_OPCs <- RunPCA(DATA_OPCs, npcs = 30)
DATA_OPCs <- RunUMAP(DATA_OPCs, dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(DATA_OPCs, split.by = "Condition")
# Redo the clustering ----
DATA_OPCs <- FindNeighbors(DATA_OPCs, dims = 1:30, k.param =7)

for (res in c(0.1, 0.15,0.16,0.17,0.18,0.2,0.25,0.3,0.35,0.4,0.45, 0.5,0.55,0.6,0.65,0.75, 1,1.25, 1.5,1.75, 2,2.25, 2.5,3)) {
  print(paste0("current res", res))
    DATA_OPCs <- FindClusters(DATA_OPCs, graph.name = "CCA_snn", resolution = res, algorithm = 1)
}

clustree(DATA_OPCs@meta.data, prefix = "CCA_snn_res.") #resolution set to 0.15

#Annotation
DATA_OPCs <- SetIdent(DATA_OPCs, value = "CCA_snn_res.0.15")
new.ids <- c("COP",
             "OPC 1",
             "OPC 2")

new.ids <- setNames(new.ids,as.character(0:(length(new.ids)-1) ))
DATA_OPCs$Subtypes <- new.ids [ match( as.character(DATA_OPCs$CCA_snn_res.0.15) , names(new.ids))  ]

saveRDS(DATA_OPCs,"data/nuclei/Nuclei_DATA_OPCs.rds")
DimPlot(DATA_OPCs, group.by = "Subtypes", pt.size =2) + ggtitle("OPCs Subtypes")

#DEGs between conditions in OPCs----
DefaultAssay(DATA_OPCs) <- "RNA"
DATA_OPCs <- DATA_OPCs %>% SetIdent(value= "Condition")
detable_all <- FindAllMarkers(DATA_OPCs, log2FC.threshold = 0.25,
    min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.2, only.pos = TRUE, max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
    assay = "RNA")

detable_all <- detable_all[ detable_all$p_val < 0.05,  ]
detable_all$pct.diff <- detable_all$pct.1 - detable_all$pct.2
detable_all$log.pct.diff <- log2(detable_all$pct.1 / (detable_all$pct.2+0.01) )
detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-50, p_val) %>% top_n(10, log.pct.diff) -> top10_all

plot_dots(DATA_OPCs, genes = c(as.character(unique(top10_all$gene))),assay = "RNA",clustering = "Condition", pal = c("#cfc8d7","#a577f2", "#0434ff"),show_grid = F,main = "DEG of OPC",cex.row = 0.8,cex.col = 0.7)

write.csv(top10_all, file = "results/nuclei/Ols/OPC_top10.csv")
write.csv(detable_all, file = "results/nuclei/Ols/OPC_DEG_Condition.csv")
```

```{r Lineage Inference}
# Perform Lineage Inference on Oligodendrocyte Lineage Cells----
DATA_OLs <- readRDS("data/nuclei/Nuclei_DATA_OL.rds")
plot_meta(x = DATA_OLs,red = "umap",feat = "Subtypes",frame=F,label = T)

Umap3d <- DATA_OLs@reductions$umap3d@cell.embeddings
Umap2d <- DATA_OLs@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
KNN <- DATA_OLs@graphs$CCA_snn
clustering <-factor(DATA_OLs$Subtypes)
mm <- sparse.model.matrix(~0 + factor(clustering))
colnames(mm) <- levels(factor(clustering))
centroids3d <- as.matrix(t(t(Umap3d) %*% mm)/Matrix::colSums(mm))
centroids2d <- as.matrix(t(t(Umap2d) %*% mm)/Matrix::colSums(mm))

df <- data.frame(Umap3d, variable = clustering)
colnames(df)[1:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2", "UMAP_3")
p_State <- plot_ly(df, x = ~UMAP_1, y = ~UMAP_2, z = ~UMAP_3, color = ~variable, size = 0.5)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(p_State, selfcontained = T, "results/nuclei/Ols/umap_3d_clustering_plotly.html")
p_State

# calculate the distance from every cell to its neighbors
expected_U2d <- t(t(Umap2d) %*% KNN)/colSums2(KNN)
d <- rowSums((expected_U2d - Umap2d)^2)^(1/2)

# Define a distance cutoff
hist(d, breaks = 400)
cutoff <- mean(d) + 5 * sd(d)
abline(v = (cutoff), col = "red", xpd = F)
to_keep <- (d < cutoff)

mypar()
plot(Umap2d, type = "n")
draw_graph <- function(layout, graph, lwd = 0.2, col = "grey") {
    res <- rep(x = 1:(length(graph@p) - 1), times = (graph@p[-1] - graph@p[-length(graph@p)]))
    segments(x0 = layout[graph@i + 1, 1], x1 = layout[res, 1], y0 = layout[graph@i +
        1, 2], y1 = layout[res, 2], lwd = lwd, col = col)
}
draw_graph(layout = Umap2d, graph = KNN)
pal <- c((scales::hue_pal())(8), RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Set1"), RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8,
    "Set2"))
set.seed(1)
pal <- rep(sample(pal, length(pal)), 200)
points(Umap2d, cex = ifelse(!to_keep, 1, 0.3), lwd = ifelse(!to_keep, 2, 0), bg = pal[clustering],
    pch = 21)
text(centroids2d, labels = rownames(centroids2d), cex = 1, font = 2)

new_UMAP2 <- Umap2d
res <- as.matrix(t(t(Umap2d) %*% KNN)/colSums2(KNN))
new_UMAP2[!to_keep, ] <- res[!to_keep, ]

new_centroids2d <- as.matrix(t(t(new_UMAP2) %*% mm)/Matrix::colSums(mm))

mypar()
plot(new_UMAP2, type = "n")
draw_graph(layout = new_UMAP2, graph = KNN)
points(new_UMAP2, cex = ifelse(!to_keep, 1, 0.3), lwd = ifelse(!to_keep, 2, 0), bg = pal[clustering],
    pch = 21)
text(new_centroids2d, labels = rownames(new_centroids2d), cex = 1, font = 2)

# Run Slingshot on UMAP2d
set.seed(1)
lineages <- as.SlingshotDataSet(getLineages(data = Umap2d, clusterLabels = clustering))
lineages

mypar(1, 2)
# Plot the lineages
plot(Umap2d, col = pal[clustering], cex = 0.5, pch = 16)
lines(lineages, lwd = 2, col = "black", cex = 3)
text(new_centroids2d, labels = rownames(new_centroids2d), cex = 0.8, font = 2, col = "white")
curves <- as.SlingshotDataSet(getCurves(lineages, thresh = 0.1, stretch = 0.1, allow.breaks = F,
    approx_points = 100))
plot(Umap2d, col = pal[clustering], pch = 16)
lines(curves, lwd = 2, col = "black")
text(centroids2d, labels = rownames(centroids2d),
    cex = 1, font = 2)
```
